title: Is your savings account taking 72 years to double your money?
caption: Rule of 72: 72 ÷ interest rate ≈ years to double. 1% → about 72 years. 7% → about 10 years. $1,000 left for 72 years: $2,047 at 1% vs $130,506 at 7%. 7% is an assumed long-run stock average, not guaranteed; markets can drop. Not financial advice. #ruleof72 #investing #personalfinance #moneytips
